text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, Trainer. Your team has been
working
so hard.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing special,
but I brought a little
present
for you all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I hope the improved conditions will help
with your
training. Good luck! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The team is delighted by the thoughtful
gift and
the clubroom upgrade, and our
bonds grow
deeper!
